subject.title: Plugin SDK: add native registerMcpServer for managed MCP

question: Should OpenClaw add a public Plugin SDK API that lets plugins register OpenClaw-managed stdio MCP servers for embedded runs?
rationale: This cannot be safely resolved as cleanup because it adds a public plugin API and a plugin-controlled process-launching/tool-exposure boundary with product and security tradeoffs.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow SDK design
options.body: Add a maintainer-owned design/implementation path for validated stdio-only registration with explicit precedence, workspace scoping, disablement, operator visibility, and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep bundle/config MCP only
options.body: Decline dynamic native registration for now and direct plugin authors to static bundle-style MCP or user-managed `mcp.servers` until the security model is stronger.

options.title: Defer pending stronger use cases
options.body: Leave the issue open but require a concrete plugin proof showing bundle/config MCP cannot satisfy the dynamic inventory without unsafe ad hoc APIs.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow SDK design
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-owned design/implementation path for validated stdio-only registration with explicit precedence, workspace scoping, disablement, operator visibility, and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Current source blame and recent SDK/plugin-boundary work make this the strongest available routing candidate for the public API and security-boundary decision.
